context: Fourth quarter, tied, 30 seconds left. Fourth and goal from the 2.

options.reason: Tied with 30 seconds left, a 20-yard field goal is almost automatic and wins the game. Take the sure points.
Going for the touchdown from the 2 is tempting, but a stop leaves you with nothing. The kick wins the game.
Punting from the 2-yard line would be one of the strangest calls ever made. You are already at the goal line.
